name: @cordis-app/tool-create-skill
description: Tool 'create_skill' — lets the model save a new skill from inside a chat, writing $DSH_HOME/skills/<name>/SKILL.md directly (dsh-skill-filesystem's own real user root). Adapted from example-2/packages/tool/create-skill, simplified since this app is single-admin (no per-user browser round-trip needed).
comment_dependencies: Deliberately none here beyond the cordis peer — see packages/llm/openai-compat/package.json's own comment_dependencies for the real prior bug this avoids. @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools, dsh-skill, and dsh-home-paths are all declared once, at the root package.json, and resolve here via plain Node upward directory-walk resolution through the single hoisted root node_modules.
